تنتحري (form VIII)
# تَنْتَحِرِي (tantaḥirī) /tan.ta.ħi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# تُنْتَحَرِي (tuntaḥarī) /tun.ta.ħa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
